testcase.name: an entry whose kept data falls inside a kept, downloaded region reports that region
an entry with no kept offline region decisions reports none, even if a covering region is downloaded
an entry whose kept data falls outside a kept, downloaded region's tiles reports none
an entry with no resolvable coordinates at all reports none and does not throw
a withheld offline region decision is never checked, even if its region is downloaded and covers the data
a covering, downloaded region the entry never kept is not reported
a kept region deleted from the device is treated as unavailable, without error
